nodes.title: Suspected appendicitis
nodes.detail: Nonpregnant adult with acute right iliac fossa or compatible abdominal pain

nodes.title: Assess stability and peritonitis
nodes.detail: Resuscitate and escalate shock, sepsis, generalized peritonitis or suspected perforation

nodes.title: Risk stratify
nodes.detail: AIR/AAS plus laboratory assessment; account for age, sex and comorbidity

nodes.title: Selective imaging
nodes.detail: Ultrasound first when appropriate; CT for unresolved adult uncertainty; pregnancy-specific pathway when relevant

nodes.title: Uncomplicated or complicated?
nodes.detail: Use clinical, imaging and operative findings

nodes.title: Uncomplicated branch
nodes.detail: Laparoscopic appendectomy within 24 hours or selected antibiotic-first care with shared decision-making and monitoring

nodes.title: Pre-incision prophylaxis
nodes.detail: Saudi MOH cefazolin plus metronidazole single-dose regimen after contraindication and formulary check

nodes.title: Complicated branch
nodes.detail: Urgent source control and local antimicrobial pathway; resolve duration conflict before prescribing

nodes.title: Disposition and follow-up
nodes.detail: Histopathology, recurrence plan and neoplasm assessment after periappendiceal abscess
